reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin and library for on-demand OCR of local images on macOS and Windows, returning recognized text and related metadata.

summaries.zh: 通过 macOS Vision 或 Windows Media OCR 为 DeepSeek Harness 按需识别本地图片中的文字。
summaries.en: An on-demand DeepSeek Harness plugin that recognizes text in local images using macOS Vision or Windows Media OCR.

capabilities: Reads a local image from an absolute path supplied to the OCR tool
Extracts text from images using macOS Vision or Windows Media OCR
Returns recognized text, confidence, engine, and duration metadata
